summary: Avricore Health Inc., a TSXV-listed foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, covering its September 2026 period, whose sole exhibit is a September 1, 2026 news release. The registrant disclosed that NHS England confirmed national expansion of the Barts Health pharmacy cholesterol testing programme powered by its HealthTab platform, with roughly 100 English pharmacies offering seven-minute checks beginning this fall through spring 2027. No securities, ownership, pricing, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are involved; it is an ordinary operational update, requiring no special-situations categorization.
